headline: Central Front Re-Ignites as Heavy Fighting Surges Across Spine
war_summary: Following a brief lull, the central theater has erupted back into violent motion, overturning the relative calm reported in our previous dispatch while the eastern front simmers down. Weathered Expanse stands once more as the war's deadliest sector, tallying five fresh base exchanges in the past two hours amidst blistering firefights around Wightwalk and Frostmarch, with casualty rates rocketing above 1,200 men an hour. Immediately south, Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands have resumed intense engagements; Linn of Mercy logged two base flips alongside a dramatic surge in losses near The Long Whine, while Dead Lands recorded three base contests and severe Warden attrition near Callahan's Boot and The Salt March. The contagion of battle has spread into neighboring sectors as well: Callahan's Passage broke out in sudden, heavy clashes around The Latch, and Marban Hollow registered three base transitions centering on Mox. By contrast, the eastern archipelagos of Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts, so heavily contested earlier, recorded zero strategic base transfers over the last two hours as combatants dig in.
